text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)] of class
1-A.
It
has
been
some
time
since
last
we met.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_02
text: Are you here to eat as well?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_select_01
text: Yep! I’m starving

label: kizuna_home_b_select_02
text: I just kind of wandered in

label: kizuna_home_b_03a
text: Ha! Excellent. You shouldn’t battle on an empty\nstomach.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_03b
text: Drawn in by the irresistible aromas, I imagine.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_04
text: I myself am here to...survey the student cafeteria,\nlet’s say.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_05
text: I am observing the nutritional content of the food\nthat our students partake of on a regular basis.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_06
text: One item on the menu here that I am particularly\ninterested in is the Peanut Butter Sandwich.\r\nIt is sweet and quite delicious.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_07
text: Yes...perhaps I will order one right now.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_mob_01
text: Oh look! It’s Mr. Saguaro! He’s so fashionable\nand cool.

label: kizuna_home_b_mob_02
text: I guess the teachers come to the cafeteria too,\nhuh? D’you think he’ll have an Egg Sandwich?

label: kizuna_home_b_mob_03
text: No way! If he gets anything here, it’ll definitely\nbe something spicy, like the Five-Alarm Sandwich!

label: kizuna_home_b_mob_04
text: Ahhh! He’s so cool! He’ll definitely get that wild\nand spicy Five-Alarm Sandwich!

label: kizuna_home_b_09
text: Could I have a...Five-Alarm Sandwich? I do enjoy\nthe thrill of spicy food.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_select_03
text: But, Mr. Saguaro! What about...?

label: kizuna_home_b_select_04
text: No! Have a Peanut Butter Sandwich!

label: kizuna_home_b_10
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]A-ah, yes. You suggested I have a Peanut Butter
Sandwich,
M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?
I
suppose
I
shall
have
to
try
one.
If
you insist.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_11
text: That was close. I almost forced myself to order\nsomething spicy—my least favorite of flavors.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_12
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I thank you for restraining me,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_13
text: It seems that the students tend to view me as\nfashionable and cool...or even—dare I say it?—\r\nexuding a sort of brooding strength.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_14
text: I have a habit of acting in such a way so as not to\ndestroy their image of me.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_15
text: I showed my true colors to you just now without\nthinking. Please keep this as a secret between us.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_b_system_01
text: You became even closer with Mr. Saguaro!
